ABOUT TORILO ACADEMY

Torilo Academy is a technology training institution in Nigeria that helps people build practical digital skills for careers in the technology industry.

CORE TRAINING AREAS

Torilo Academy provides technology and digital skills training in areas including:

- Software Development
- Product Design (UI/UX)
- Data Analysis

LEARNING FORMATS

Torilo Academy provides learning through three formats:

- Online classes

These learning formats are designed to support students, career switchers, entrepreneurs and working professionals.

CAREER SUPPORT

Career support may include:

- Internship opportunities
- LinkedIn profile optimization

Ikeja Campus:

VGC Lekki Campus:

in Ikeja, Lagos.

PROGRAMME NAME

AI Engineering

PROGRAMME DURATION

The AI Engineering programme runs for 4 months.

PROGRAMME DESCRIPTION

The AI Engineering programme is designed to help students develop practical skills for building artificial intelligence applications and systems.

PROGRAMME

develop practical skills for building artificial intelligence applications and systems.

PROGRAMME TOPICS

The AI Engineering programme covers:

- Python Programming for AI
- Mathematics and Statistics for AI
- Data Processing and Analysis
- Machine Learning Fundamentals
- Supervised Learning
- Unsupervised Learning
- Deep Learning
- Neural Networks
- Natural Language Processing
- Generative AI
- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Prompt Engineering
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Vector Databases
- Semantic Search
- AI Agents and Tool Use
- AI Application Development
- Model Evaluation
- AI Deployment
- AI Engineering Projects

SUITABILITY FOR STUDENTS INTERESTED IN AI

Students interested in machine learning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Large Language Models (LLMs), and

in machine learning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Large Language Models (LLMs), and building practical AI applications may consider the AI Engineering programme.
